tool.help:
**What it does**
SmartTile splits point clouds into tiles for segmentation and species models, puts the predicted tiles back together and transfers the predictions onto the original files. Inputs must use a projected CRS in metres.
- **Tile and subsample**: buffered spatial tiles at up to three voxel sizes or the original resolution, or tiles in which every existing tree stays whole. Also writes a tile bounds JSON and a preview image. - **Filter / merge segmented tiles**: removes the buffer overlap between segmented tiles and joins trees cut by tile borders. The remap target transfers the predictions onto finer subsampled tiles first, writes the original files with the predictions like Remap, or is none (filter at the segmented voxel size). RayCloudTools tree tables and meshes are filtered together with the tiles. RayCloudTools terrain meshes are optional: each tile keeps the triangles in its core, and every original gets the terrain over its own points (originals that cover the same ground share it). - **Remap predictions to originals**: copies the predicted dimensions of one or more prediction collections onto the original files. Every original point must be covered. With the tree tables of merged RayCloudTools tiles it also writes the tree tables, tree meshes and terrain mesh of every original. - **Create merged file**: joins several prediction sets of the same originals into one LAZ, COPC LAZ or PLY file.
**Segmentation**
.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/smarttile_segmentation.png :width: 100%
Tile the originals at 10 cm for the model and at 1 cm as high-resolution targets. Merge the segmented tiles with the tile bounds JSON, then remap them onto the originals. For a single model without species prediction, **Remap target → Original files** writes the originals directly.
**Species per tree**
.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/smarttile_whole_instances.png :width: 80%
Tile originals that already carry tree IDs with **Keep existing instances whole**, run the species model, and remap with **Match within the same existing instance**.
**Several models in one file**
.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/smarttile_merged_file.png :width: 40%
Remap each model separately, then add each result as a **Collection** of **Create merged file**. For ForestStructure, choose full resolution, COPC LAZ and **Add OriginalPointIndex**.
